memory: I believe that building a strong network is crucial for success in the business world. It's not just about having a list of contacts, but about cultivating meaningful relationships that can provide valuable insights and support. My relationship with Sarah Chen, CEO of Pacific Dynamics, is a great example of this. We met at a Goldman conference in 2008, but it was a delayed flight from Hong Kong six months later that really solidified our connection. We spent five hours discussing market trends, our shared love of jazz, and other topics, laying the foundation for a lasting partnership. Now, she's not just a business contact, but someone I can trust to provide honest answers about Asian markets at any time. This kind of network is essential for making informed decisions and achieving success in the industry.I believe that building a strong network is crucial for success in the business world.
